page.layout: Running head across top, centred; page number "Pag. 3" top right. Main text in one column with a large woodcut initial. Title block at full width above the text. Right margin: handwritten annotation (manuscript, not printed, so omitted from text). Signature "A 2" at foot, catchword "dequè" at right below last line.

main_text.head: DANIELIS BERCKRINGERI ENCOMIUM STUDII POLITICI VERE ARCHITECTONICI.
main_text.p: AEquè fortean gravem & grandem vobis committere videbor [?]olœcismum Politicum, AUDITORES, quòd ego, homo Philosophus, qui usquè in umbrâ, nunquam in luce atque oculis Reipublicæ vixi, nullamquè ejus partem domi militiævè attigi, de Majestate Studii Politici hinc ad vos verbigerari præsumam, æquè, inquam, gravem & grandem solœcismum Politicum, atque olim, illud humanæ sapientiæ terrestre oraculum Socrates, solœcismum Oeconomicum, qui, cùm vix quinque minarum rem in patrimonio haberet, Critolaum nihilominùs artem opulescendi docuit, faciem tenùs insipienter, verà interim re sapientissimè, ut non immeritò de triumvirali collegio sapientum, Sophocles sapiens, Euripides sapientior, Socrates verò sapientissimus, domi audierit inter suos: Phormio hinc Peripateticus solœcismum Ethico-Polemicum, quem, cùm apud Hannibalem, exulantem exilium in Asiâ, aliquot horas de officio imperatorio, dequè

page.notes: Handwritten marginal annotation in red ink at right edge ("imp... vénie... sition... orat...") is manuscript, not printed. Initial A is a woodcut ornamented letter; the first letter is read as A. The word at line start "[?]olœcismum" is partly obscured by the initial; the reading "solœcismum" is likely. Catchword "dequè" at foot right.
